Executive Summary

Product vision, goals, and KPIs

🕉️
Product Vision: Anant Kashi Gurukulam PWA is a modern, installable Progressive Web App designed to digitise and amplify the mission of faith-based and religious organisations — temples, gurukuls, spiritual centres, and astrology practices — by unifying devotee engagement, Vedic learning, live puja participation, donation management, and astrology marketplace capabilities into a single, beautifully designed mobile-first platform. The app is fully installable on Android, iOS, and desktop browsers via PWA standards (Web App Manifest + Service Worker), works across all modern web browsers without requiring App Store approval, and operates in partial offline mode to ensure continuous access to spiritual content regardless of connectivity. It serves domestic Gurukuls (targeting ₹3–5L engagement projects) and NRI diaspora Gurukuls internationally ($10–15K).
🎯 Core Objectives
  • Accessible Vedic learning (courses, lessons, quizzes, certificates)
  • Live puja and event streaming with RSVP and Zoom integration
  • Automated donation splits with transparent payout ledger
  • Astrologer marketplace with booking and scheduling
  • AI-assisted meditation coaching and daily spiritual reminders
  • Unified admin control panel for content and finance
  • NRI diaspora support with multi-currency donations (INR + USD)
  • Scalable VILT + DDD architecture for future feature expansion
📊 Success KPIs
Metric Target
Visitor → Registered User ≥ 5% (Post-Launch Year 1)
Course Completion Rate ≥ 40% (paid)
Astrologer Booking Conversion ≥ 20%
Donation Receipt Generation 100% automated
Lighthouse Mobile Score ≥ 80 (prod)
PWA Installs (Post-Launch Year 1) ≥ 500 active
Net Promoter Score ≥ 45
Target Users

Target Users & Use Cases

Personas, goals, pain points, and primary use cases

🏛️
Gurukul Administrator
Admin / Finance
Manages events, priests, content publishing, and donation reconciliation. Needs a unified dashboard to replace manual spreadsheet workflows.
  • Publish puja schedule and events
  • View donation ledger and trigger payouts
  • Manage astrologer listings and KYC
  • Generate 80G tax receipts for donors
🙋
Volunteer / Sevak
Coordinator
Coordinates events, tracks volunteer slots, and sends reminders. Needs mobile-first tools that work even with poor connectivity at venues.
  • RSVP and track event attendance
  • Receive WhatsApp reminders for duties
  • Share event links via WhatsApp
🤲
Devotee / Donor
Primary User
Seeks authentic spiritual content, wishes to donate transparently, and wants instant receipts with split breakdown. Primary mobile user, aged 35–65.
  • One-tap recurring donations
  • Watch live pujas and join aarti
  • Download 80G tax receipts
  • Browse and enroll in courses
🎓
Student / Sadhak
Learner
Aged 16–35, wants structured Vedic education with progress tracking and certificates. Expects offline access to lessons during travel.
  • Enroll in Sanskrit and Vedic courses
  • Track lesson progress offline
  • Download shareable certificates
  • Attend live online workshops
🧘
Meditation Practitioner
Wellness Seeker
Uses guided meditation modules, tracks streaks, and needs daily reminder notifications. Values calm, distraction-free spiritual UI.
  • Access guided meditation library
  • Set daily Sadhana reminders
  • Track meditation streak and minutes
  • Receive Shloka of the Day notifications
🌟
Astrologer / Coach
Service Provider
Offers paid consultations, manages appointment calendar, and needs a simple dashboard to track earnings and upcoming bookings. Wants easy payout access.
  • Create and manage service listings
  • View booking calendar and earnings
  • Chat or video consult with clients
  • Track payout status and history
💡
NRI Diaspora Note: A key secondary audience is NRI devotees in the US, UK, Canada, and Australia who donate in USD/GBP and participate in live pujas across time zones. Multi-currency support and timezone-aware scheduling are Phase 1 requirements for international appeal and revenue.

Design System
4

Design System & Visual Guide

Dual-direction strategy, design tokens, component rules, glassmorphism, and motion

🎨
Dual Visual Strategy: The app uses Material Design 3 for admin, utility, and form-heavy flows (ensuring accessibility and developer velocity) and Glassmorphism + Neumorphism accents for public-facing spiritual pages (hero, donation, meditation, puja streaming) where emotional resonance and warmth take priority. A hybrid component system bridges both directions seamlessly.
🏗️ Direction A — Material Design 3
  • Applied to: Admin panel, booking forms, course catalog, auth flows
  • Elevation via surface tones and tonal containers (M3 colour roles)
  • Consistent 8px grid, 4px baseline grid
  • Accessible touch targets ≥ 48×48px
  • State layers: hover 8%, pressed 12%, focus 12% opacity
  • Ripple effects on all interactive elements
  • Snackbars, dialogs, bottom sheets follow M3 specifications
  • Dynamic colour theming via CSS custom properties
✨ Direction B — Glass + Neumorphism
  • Applied to: Hero banners, donation widget, meditation cards, puja hero
  • Frosted glass overlays on deep dark or photo backgrounds
  • Neumorphic buttons for primary spiritual CTAs (soft inset/emboss)
  • Saffron glow accents replace harsh drop shadows
  • backdrop-filter: blur(16–24px) with 55–65% white alpha
  • Only on surfaces with sufficient dark background (luminance ≤ 40%)
  • Fallback: solid semi-transparent surface for unsupporting browsers
  • High contrast text always maintained ≥ 4.5:1

🧱 Component Rules
📲 App Shell / Header
  • Height 56px (mobile), 64px (desktop)
  • Logo left, action icons right (bell, chat)

  • Sticky bottom, height 72px, 5–6 items
  • Active state: saffron-600 icon + label
  • Touch target ≥ 48×48px per item
  • Badge counter for unread notifications

🦸 Hero Section
  • Dark gradient background (spiritual warmth)
  • Left: eyebrow label + H1 + subtitle + CTA
  • Right: Guruji image in rounded/circular crop
  • CTA: saffron pill button, 44px min height

📋 Course / Event Cards
  • Thumbnail 16:9 or square with emoji fallback
  • Language badge top-left (pill, saffron-100)
  • Title: Playfair Display 15px/700
  • Progress bar if enrolled (4px, saffron gradient)
  • Hover: translateY(-2px) + border-color transition
🪙 Donation Widget
  • 3-column preset amount grid
  • Custom input with ₹ prefix indicator
  • Live split preview updates on every keystroke
  • Coloured dots per recipient category
  • CTA: full-width, gradient saffron, 52px height
📅 Booking Modal (Bottom Sheet)
  • Slides up 85vh on mobile, handle bar drag-dismiss
  • Date strip (5 days) + time slot grid (3 col)
  • Unavailable slots: 40% opacity, cursor not-allowed
  • Confirm CTA locked until slot + notes filled
  • Focus trapped inside modal while open
🔘 Buttons
  • Primary: saffron fill, dark text, 44px, rounded-full
  • Secondary: saffron border, transparent fill
  • Danger: danger border, danger text
  • Icon btn: 40×40px circle, bg-warm, hover bg-saffron-100
  • Disabled: 40% opacity, cursor not-allowed
📝 Forms & Inputs
  • Label: 11px uppercase, 0.8px letter-spacing
  • Input: 48px height, border-1 → saffron on focus
  • Error: danger border + inline message below
  • Select: custom arrow icon, consistent styling
  • Textarea: min-height 96px, resize vertical only

CSS Property Value Notes
background rgba(255,255,255,0.55–0.65) Adjust opacity based on background darkness. Darker bg = lower opacity needed.
backdrop-filter blur(16px) saturate(1.4) Use 12–24px blur depending on glass panel size.
-webkit-backdrop-filter blur(16px) saturate(1.4) Required for Safari iOS support. Always include both.
border 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.35) Light inner border creates glass edge illusion.
border-radius 16–28px Larger radius for glass panels; matches overall radius-lg/xl tokens.
Fallback background rgba(255,255,255,0.92) For browsers without backdrop-filter support (@supports check).
Background requirement Luminance ≤ 40% Only apply glass on dark or photo backgrounds. Never on light cream backgrounds.
Text contrast Minimum 4.5:1 against glass bg Use dark text (#1A1208) on frosted white glass panels.
Neumorphic button No box-shadow; use border + bg shift Soft inset: bg-cream-deep + darker border. Emboss: bg-white + saffron border highlight.
🎬 Motion Guidelines & Tokens
Token Value Used For
motion-micro 80ms ease-out Icon state changes, checkbox toggle, badge update
motion-fast 120ms ease-out Button hover/active states, chip selection, tab switch
motion-medium 240ms cubic-bezier(0.2,0.8,0.2,1) Card hover lift, modal open, toast appear, screen slide
motion-slow 360ms cubic-bezier(0.2,0.8,0.2,1) Bottom sheet slide-up, page transitions, drawer open
motion-spring 500ms cubic-bezier(0.34,1.56,0.64,1) Splash logo scale, success celebration, badge pop
scroll-reveal fade + translateY(12px) → 0 Section entrances on scroll; 80ms stagger per child item
♿
prefers-reduced-motion: All CSS transitions and JavaScript animations MUST check @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce). Either remove transition-duration entirely (instant) or switch to opacity-only fades (no movement). Splash loader dots must be static. Scroll-reveal animations must be disabled. This is a WCAG 2.1 AAA requirement and a non-negotiable implementation detail.

Technical Architecture

PWA requirements, VILT + DDD stack, infrastructure, auth, and payment contracts

🎤 Real-Time Communication Architecture — In-App WebSockets Chat + ZegoCloud Voice Calling
💬 1. In-App Chat (WebSockets):

Lightweight WebSocket server (Node.js / Socket.io / Laravel Reverb) self-hosted directly on the Hostinger VPS. When a user types a message, it travels instantly through an active WebSocket connection to the server and routes directly to the recipient with typing indicators, read receipts, and session chat logs. Virtually free to run (≈ ₹0 incremental cost) — easily handles thousands of concurrent text messages.

📞 2. In-App Voice Call (ZegoCloud Express Audio SDK):

Drop-in ZegoCloud Express Audio SDK handles ultra-low latency real-time audio, hardware echo cancellation, and network jitter without building complex WebRTC media servers. The custom WebSocket server acts as the signalling mechanism (firing an invisible WebSocket message that triggers an “Incoming Call” popup window on the recipient’s device). Once accepted, ZegoCloud connects both parties. 10,000 free monthly minutes included, then only ~$0.99 (~₹83) per 1,000 participant-minutes (e.g. 30-min call ≈ ₹5).

Accessibility & Compliance
6

Accessibility & Compliance

WCAG 2.1 AA standards, Indian legal compliance, and international regulatory requirements

♿ WCAG 2.1 AA Requirements
  • Colour contrast ≥ 4.5:1 for normal text; ≥ 3:1 for large text (18px+)
  • All interactive elements keyboard-navigable; visible focus ring
  • Focus order matches visual reading order (logical tab sequence)
  • Images have descriptive alt text; decorative images alt=""
  • Form inputs have associated <label> elements (for/id pair)
  • Error messages announced by screen reader (aria-live="polite")
  • Bottom sheet modals trap focus; Escape key dismisses
  • Video and audio lessons include captions or transcript toggle
  • Touch targets ≥ 44×44px (Apple HIG) / ≥ 48×48px (Material)
  • No content flashes more than 3 times per second (seizure-safe)
  • Zoom to 200% without horizontal scroll on 320px viewport
  • Donation flow fully operable with VoiceOver and TalkBack
  • Devanagari text does not clip or overflow on all breakpoints
⚖️ Legal & Regulatory Compliance
80G Tax Receipts Mandatory for all INR donations; include PAN, Section 80G reference, donor details, and split breakdown
FCRA Genuine “foreign contributions” (from foreign nationals / OCI-PIO cardholders) legally require FCRA registration and must route to the designated SBI, Sansad Marg account — a payment gateway cannot substitute for this. NRI donors who remain Indian citizens, paying from personal savings, are generally exempt. CA sign-off required before enabling international donations live — see the callout in Section 8.
TRAI DLT (SMS) Not required for this build — OTP is delivered via WhatsApp (Meta Cloud API, reuses the WABA already set up for broadcast) with Firebase Phone Auth as fallback. Both routes fall outside TRAI’s DLT mandate, which applies only to traditional telecom-routed SMS. DLT stays available as a future option (~₹5,900 + GST one-time, 3–7 working days) if a branded SMS sender ID is ever required.
DPDP Act 2023 Consent banners on first launch; data minimisation policy; right to deletion API endpoint
PCI DSS Use hosted payment pages only; zero card data ever stored on server; SAQ-A compliance
KYC for Payouts Aadhaar + PAN mandatory for all astrologers receiving payouts exceeding ₹50,000/year
GST 18% GST on paid course subscriptions; GST invoice generation via Razorpay billing module
GDPR / UK GDPR Cookie consent for GA4 analytics for NRI users in EU/UK; data residency option on request

  • #1 Recommendation (Batch size ≤ 100 students + interactive recordings): Choose Zoom Pro (~₹1,300–₹1,450/month · ₹15,600–17,400/yr). It provides superior host controls, waiting rooms, breakout rooms, and smoother screen-sharing annotation tools.

⚖️
Foreign-currency donations via Razorpay — please read before enabling: Razorpay can technically process international cards and bank transfers, and this is built into the base gateway integration (line 3.2 above). However, under India’s FCRA, 2010, a genuine “foreign contribution” to a religious/charitable entity must legally be received for the first time only in the designated FCRA bank account (SBI, Main Branch, Sansad Marg, New Delhi) — an ordinary payment gateway settlement account cannot satisfy this. Donations from NRIs who remain Indian citizens, paid from personal savings through normal banking channels, are generally not treated as foreign contribution and can be accepted via Razorpay directly. Donations from foreign nationals, OCI/PIO cardholders, or foreign entities are foreign contributions and require FCRA registration/compliance regardless of gateway. Recommendation: get sign-off from the Gurukul’s CA before enabling the international-donation flow live — Digital Builders will build the technical capability but this is a legal compliance decision, not a technical one.
